acceptance_function_scope: Shared numerical bar function only; no sealed admission, reserve read or transport.
decision: Do not promote the server-recognizer configuration. Retain the English recognizer and V44/V27/V5 baseline; frozen V46 remains a diagnostic arm with its training outcome unchanged. Investigate symbol-only OCR masks and the eight additional wrong-phase CSV rows separately.
evidence_curation: Raw before/after observations and the comparison summary retain all changed OCR and calibration fields. This publication keeps metrics, paired truth gains/losses, accepted-marker changes and change counts without duplicating those full observations.
license_review: Reused the existing pinned Apache-2.0 PP-OCRv5 server recognizer, converted ONNX payload, manifest and reviewed notices. Detector and marker payloads, application/runtime assemblies and dependencies are unchanged.
limitations: Only detection recall clears the five shared composed-OCR bars; precision, literal exact recognition, character error rate and role accuracy fail.
The extra CSV export is a train case. Dev remains 156/206 correct values and 156/224 rows; wrong-phase rows rise from three to eleven.
Native exact text improves by 29 recovered and nine lost readings, while native markers gain one and lose eleven. Net totals alone would hide these regressions.
Prior numeric exports are not byte-identical: all 15 previously completed sources have some changed numeric row tuples. Full source-specific changes, calibrations and audit artifacts remain bound.

No private/sealed read, optimizer, new model download, source rebuild, activation, packaged build or release occurred. Existing 1083 passing tests and 16 optional skips are reused from the exact unchanged runtime; this comparison does not claim another test run.
